main_text.p: hammedem inter homines præstantior quam Ali, & post ipsum filii ipsius, nomine designati, hominum præstantissimi sint, apparuisse Deum formâ ipsorum, locutum ipsorum lingua, & manibus ipsorum usum, ideoque (inquiunt) Deitatis appellationem ipsis tribuimus. Quin & multa Alis facta narrant miranda, atque inter cæ-tera quod portas Chaibar loco moverit quod esse vo-lunt مِنْ أَجْلِ الدَّلِيلِ عَلَى أَنَّ فِيهِ جُزْءًا الْإِلَهِيًّا وَقُوَّةٌ رَبَّانِيَّةٌ argumentum manifestum, fuisse in eo parti-culam aliquam divinam, & potentiam cælestem, eumque fuisse ipsum الَّذِي ظَهَرَ الْإِلَهُ بِصُورَتِهِ وَخَلَقَ بِيَدَيْهِ وَأَمَرَ السَادَةَ وَعَنْ هَذَا قَالُوا كَانَ هُوَ مَوْجُودٌ قَبْلَ خَلْقِ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ Cujus forma apparuit Deus, cujusque manibus [opera sua] creavit, & cujus linguâ præcepta dedit, ideoque dixerunt extitisse ipsum ante creationem cœlorum & terra. Ita impiè detor-quere videntur quædam quæ de Christo in Scrip-turis dicuntur, ut de Ali eadem affirment. Porrò ita distingui possunt AlShii ut sint ex iis, qui dicant بِالتَّوَقُّفِ وَالِانْتِظَارِ وَالرَّجْعَةِ Sistendum atque expe-ctandum dum redeat Antistes, (scil. interruptam esse dudum Antistitum seriem, rediturum autem aliquando qui * Nam alii alium ultimum Antistitum statuunt. v. c. de الباقرية & الاثناعشرية v. c. de الصالحية* ultimus (ex eorum sententia) cum esset, disparuit & indiciis, de quibus dubitari non posset, patefaciendum, dicti hi الواقفية Alwakefi, alii autem qui dicant بِالسُّوقِ وَالتَّدْوِينَةِ (scil. continuari Antistites, nec deficere unquam qui munere illo fungatur. Imo sunt qui asserant fieri posse ut sint duo c. de الامامية simul

page.notes: The first word "hammedem" is a fragment: the initial M is cut off at the edge, kept as printed. Arabic and Greek-like passages are copied as far as legible; the Arabic in the margin notes and some vowel-less Arabic words are uncertain and should be checked against the scan. The margin note marked "*" is set beside the line "* ultimus" in the text. Note "c. de الامامية" is beside the line "Porrò ita distingui". Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. Printed "difparuit", "indiciis,de" and similar forms are transcribed with the long s as s. Google watermark at bottom right omitted.
